name: STACKC-ALLIGATOR-JAW-FILTER
logic: Stack C (Stack A + skip first Friday NFP on n021 leg) with one added condition on ALL 4 legs: Alligator jaw direction filter. Jaw = Bill Williams Alligator jaw line = 13-period SMMA (smoothed MA) of bar midpoints, shifted forward 8 bars (i.e. use the value 8 bars in the future relative to each bar, or equivalently the value of Alligator jaw that will plot at the current bar = SMMA13 calculated 8 bars ago). Direction rule: LONG legs (Mon17x22, T82) require Close > Jaw at entry bar. SHORT legs (G11-3, n021) require Close < Jaw at entry bar. All other logic identical to Stack C: G11-3 = Fri 14:00 SELL if day move > 0.3xATR14 AND MMR>=-1 AND Gate A, skip first Friday, exit 21:00; Mon17x22 = Mon 17:00 BUY if day move < -0.3xATR14 AND EMA120 slope <= +0.1xATR14, exit 22:00; T82 = Mon 15:00-16:00 BUY when prev bar LOSSY-long AND minssr>-2, exit 21:00; n021 = Fri 13:00-16:00 SELL when prev bar LOSSY AND z>=0.9 AND NOT first Friday, exit 21:00. No stops, 0.1 lot, cost 0.00008. Model 1 M15, -TimeoutMin 180, 2020-2026 per year IS+OOS.
